findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler can no longer be instantiated after switching to StatefulDetectorHandler
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler but implements none of its abstract methods (counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, build_occurrence_and_event_data). Because StatefulDetectorHandler is an ABC with unimplemented abstractmethods, calling MetricAlertDetectorHandler(detector) raises TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class. This class is wired as MetricAlertFire.detector_handler, so any time Detector.detector_handler is accessed for a detector of type 'metric_alert_fire' (e.g. inside process_detectors, which has no exception handling around handler construction), the entire detector processing loop will crash with an unhandled TypeError. Previously the handler was instantiable and evaluate() returned an empty list. Either keep it on DetectorHandler or implement the abstract methods (even as stubs) so the class remains instantiable.

findings.title: test_dedupe in TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue builds the expected occurrence with the wrong group key
findings.body: In TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe, the expected occurrence is built via build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "val1", 6, PriorityLevel.HIGH), which sets the occurrence fingerprint to handler.build_fingerprint("val1") (i.e. ["<detector_id>:val1"]). The actual call under test is handler.evaluate_group_key_value("group_key", ...), so the occurrence the handler produces has fingerprint ["<detector_id>:group_key"]. IssueOccurrence is a frozen dataclass, so DetectorEvaluationResult equality compares the fingerprint field, and this assertion fails because the fingerprints differ. The mock occurrence should be built with "group_key" instead of "val1" for this test to pass.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The docstring for StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate reads "Evaluates a given data packet and returns a list of DetectorEvaluationResult", but the signature was changed in this PR to return dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]. The docstring should be updated to describe the dict keyed by group key so implementers aren't misled about the return contract.
